Variants.Content: Anchored at Nassau Castle over the Lahn, the House of Nassau held pivotal toll passages between Mainz and Westphalia. Bearing azure heraldry with a golden lion, the counts laid the dynastic foundations that would soon propel them to imperial kingship.
Nassau bridgeheads collected vital river tolls, sustaining knightly retinues capable of repelling aggressive predatory neighbours.
